en: What do you mean, "people"? You're not trying to implicate me, I hope!
Yeah! We've done no such thing! Where's your proof!? You shouldn't assume the worst of people, Hirakawa-san!
Oh, don't take me for a fool. I'm not naive enough to fall for that line.
Bah! Say what ya will, I know nothin'!
Well, in any case, this isn't your responsibility, Suzuki-san.
Enough! We get the picture!
I'm sorry I wasn't able to help more.
(I guess I shouldn't have gotten involved in something I don't know much about.)
Muramatsu-san is right, Nakajima-san. I get the feeling that you shouldn't touch that cord.
But what'll people think if they walk in and hear this voice moanin' away!?
You said there's important information in that box, right? Do you want to risk losing it?
I guess not, no...
What on earth are you doing!?
Hirakawa-san! When did you get back?
Never mind that. Shut off that moaning sound! It's hardly appropriate for the workplace!
That's the problem. We can't. The computer got hit by a cyberterrorism attack!
Cyberterrorism? Let me see.
Oh, this is just a joke program. It's not one of those nasty viruses that steals or destroys your data.
I'll install my antivirus software for you.
Antivirus software?
Everyone knows you need antivirus software these days. Haven't you taken any precautions at all?
Didn't know I needed to.
Okay, that should do it.
The moaning stopped.
Aha! Nicely done, Hirakawa-san! Are we all good now, then?
That'll take care of the virus, so don't worry about it. But this is the kind of program you often find lurking on adult sites, Nakajima-san, Muramatsu-kun.
I'd prefer it if you didn't view those sites on work PCs from now on.
What!? I hope you're not suggesting what I think you are! I know this is the computer I use, but it wasn't me!
Yeah, me neither! Where's yer evidence, huh!? You shouldn't assume the worst of people, Hirakawa-san!
I'm just glad Suzuki-san was here to help out! I was about to pull the power plug out.
You were!? That could have ruined the hard disk!
Crisis averted thanks to Suzuki-san!
Here's a little somethin' to say thanks. Go on, take it.
(Heh, never a dull minute here.)
This is a famous postcard scene. I should've brought my camera.
Do you know what I think of when I think of Hokkaido? Streetcars. They're so adorable. I kind of love them.
My old lady's been on my case to cut down on smoking. I know she means well, but it's not like I can just give them up.
Let's go for a drink somewhere. Somewhere where the girls are pretty.
The way you walk shows you're not from around here. The locals step with their feet flush with the ground so they don't slip, you know.
Although I'm from Okinawa myself, actually.
Are you kidding me? Hokkaido's seafood is badass! It's so fresh and tasty! Cheap, too!
Oh, yeah. It's mind blowing. Hokkaido's crazy. The seafood here's nuts.
I'm freezing. Let's get inside somewhere. Anywhere.
Will you be patient? There are so many places that look good. How am I supposed to decide? Why do there have to be so many choices?
The only remedy for a cold night like this is a soak in a hot spring bath with a nice drink. Of course, it's gonna be like this every night for a while.
Did you see the news? There's a convict on the loose. Isn't it frightening? Just think. He could be watching us right now!
That's what I want to see in a man. A guy who has the initiative to break out of jail. Not like that wimp!
What did your boyfriend do this time?
Sushi's better without wasabi. That stuff just kills the natural flavor of the fish.
What're you even talking about? Wabisabi is a necessity of life, and you can't spell "wabisabi" without "wasabi."
Oww... The snow's packed down to ice here. Do you mind? Take a picture why don't you?
Why is that girl always late by half an hour? Gotta get that girl to leave thirty minutes earlier...
Man, nothing gets me pumped like a good old-fashioned Don Quijote! They've got everything you could ever want!
Did you see the news? It's getting rough out here. Take care, pal.
What do you prefer? Skiing or snowboarding? Me, I prefer sledding.
I love the freedom of traveling solo. It's kind of embarrassing to have to ask people to take photos of you, though.
Isn't it pretty? I wish I could live in a house like this.
Not likely. Maybe overseas, but here, a place this size? Think of how much the down payment would cost...
Oh... Yeah...
Are you here for the snow festival? It lifts the spirits of the whole town.
Huh? Is the snow festival this way? I'm not sure anymore. Maybe I should backtrack.
While everyone's out enjoying the festival, I read manga outside to show I'm not a sheep like them! ...Ahh-choo!
The day's fading light, its beauty is gorgeous in its fleeting frailty, but it is nothing compared to yours...
Ahaha! Seriously!? Who says that!?
You just gotta have lamb barbeque when you're in Hokkaido. That's, like, their signature dish.
No, no, no! Crab! We're having crab tonight!
I couldn't wait for our mixer to begin and got here too early. How long until someone else shows up!?
I finally asked my crush out... and got shot down. Damn! I need to drown my sorrows with a couple drinks.
This is it. Time to do or die. The doing part is so tempting, but... I don't want to catch anything.
There's supposed to be a place that serves the best seafood rice bowl around here. But this map is so hard to figure out!
I need to pick up some local gifts for friends back home. There's so much good stuff to choose from!
Marimo.
I beg your pardon?
How about Marimo moss balls?
Wait till she gets a load of this tonight! Heh! Huh? What are you staring at?
What the heck? It's already evening? I hate how night comes so quick in winter.
Hey, Suzuki-san. I wanted to ask what sort of music you listen to when racing. Something high tempo like Eurobeat tracks?
I'm not sure what you'd call it. Why do you ask?
Well, I just thought listening to some good tunes might help get you in the right state of mind when racing!
Oh, yeah. Let me give you one of my favorite CDs to listen to.
You got <Color:8>"Get to the Top!" CD<Color:Default>.
This'll really get your blood pumping! You can pick a CD just before the race to help get you amped up the win.
You can also buy CDs from the <Color:7>mobile shop<Color:Default>, so try buying a few on your phone. There are tons of different ones available!
You get a shipping email after you order and pick it up at convenience stores or your house.
(CDs, huh? I guess it would lift the spirits to listen to something while racing. Maybe I'll order from this mobile shop later.)
What's wrong, Suzuki-san? You're looking glum.
I am? This is just how I always look, though.
Don't play dumb. I can see it written all over your face. What's on your mind?
Let's say you had to live away from the people you care about. What would you do, Wada-san?
People you care about, huh?
Sorry, I shouldn't have brought this up. Forget I said anything.
If you care about them, you should've stayed.
Wha...!
They say even when apart, you're still connected in a way. That's the truth, but people aren't always as strong as they make out to be.
Still, there are plenty of ways to stay in touch even when you can't be there in person.
I guess you should do what you can now or you might regret it. But that's just what I think.
Yes, you're right. Thank you.
Heh. No worries.
You were kind of off-rhythm there, Uncle Kaz.
(Sorry about that, Haruka. I'll try to do a better job next time.)
Sir, are you familiar with Karaokekan's all-new solo karaoke room?
A solo karaoke room?
Indeed. The room features a special, high-end karaoke setup, so it's like you're in your very own personal studio!
Oh? Tell me more.
In addition to the condenser mic set up in the room for pro-grade recording, there are also high-quality headphones available for listening to the karaoke track.
These allow you to hear crisper detail in the sound, and facilitates practicing and voice training.
Sounds neat.
Yes. The monitoring headphones we provide are also used for professional recordings. They aren't like normal headphones used for listening to music.
The system can support up to two people at a time, so you can even have a second person join you, to add harmonies to your recording.
Ah, so you can invite someone along with you.
Since the room itself is set up like a true studio environment, anything made here will be of unmatched professional quality.
So you can record something much more impressive than what you could at home.
Absolutely! We highly recommend it for people who want to practice their singing and recording skills.
(Karaokekan has a special solo karaoke room. Maybe I'll talk about it at the cabaret club.)
That was a lot of fun, Uncle Kaz! Be sure to call me again sometime!
You got it.
Did you have a good time today, Haruka?
Yeah! We should sing again sometime!
Wow, you're really good at this, Kiryu-san! I'm kinda impressed!
That wasn't all that impressive, y'know.
Looks like I gotta practice more.
Well, I'm headin' back to Hakata then! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Gimme a call again sometime! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
You're amazing, Saejima-san! I really have to hand it to you.
That wasn't terribly impressive.
I need to practice more.
I need to get back on home now. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Please call me again sometime! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
You're super good, Akiyama-san! I'm kinda surprised!
Eh, that wasn't so great.
Yeah, now that's the ticket!
I gotta get back to Osaka now. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Shinada-san, you're so good at this! You definitely have my admiration.
That wasn't terribly enjoyable.
I suppose I need to practice more.
I'm heading back to Nagoya now. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Please do call me again! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
You're pretty good at this, Kiryu-san! I'm kind of surprised!
Well, singing isn't all there is to life, I guess.
Oh no, that was sooo close!
Ask me out again sometime, okay? <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
You're really good at karaoke! I'm kind of surprised!
Oh, that was sooo close!
I had a lot of fun today, Akiyama-san. Give me a call again sometime!
I'm happy to hear that. I'll be sure to invite you along again.
Today was lots of fun, Haruka-chan. Will you give me a call again sometime?
Sure! I'd love to sing together again!
Welcome! It'll be 1,000 yen for the pair of you. Shall I show you to a room?
Uncle Kaz, do you think you can get <Color:8>900 points or more?<Color:Default> Come on, give it your best shot!
(Haruka wants me to <Color:8>score at least 900 points  <Color:8> in karaoke<Color:Default>.)
Very well. If you'd follow me, please.
Oh. Okay. Maybe next time then.
Very well. Please do come again.
Not today. Sorry.
Yes, we'd like to sing.
Welcome. How many people are in your party?
Two, please.
Sorry. I should be going.
All right. That'll be 1,000 yen for the two of you.
Just one.
One, please.
Just me.
Just one!
Sorry. I've got to be going.
(Who should I call?)
There's someone else who'll be joining me.
Certainly. In that case, it'll be 1,000 yen for two people.
(I'll call up Haruka.)
Sorry to keep you waiting, Uncle Kaz!
(I'll give Haruka-chan a call.)
Sorry to keep you waiting, Akiyama-san.
(I'll call Uncle Kaz.)
Sorry to keep you waiting, Haruka.
(I'll call up Riku.)
Sorry to make y'wait! Karaoke with you sounds like a blast, Kiryu-san! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
(Guess I'll give Kaguya a call.)
Sorry for the wait! I'm looking forward to hearing you sing, Saejima-san! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
(I should give Honoka-chan a call.)
Ya called up a student who's busy lookin' for a job all the way out in Osaka, just to play sing karaoke? This some kinda joke?
My apologies.
Sorry to keep ya waitin'! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> I've been wantin' to practice my singin', actually!
(Maybe I should give Shion-chan a call.)
It really is rather rude to make me come all the way from Nagoya for this, you know. Honestly, it's not like I don't have anything better to do.
Yeah, sorry about that! I guess the travel costs must've been rough, too.
Apologies for the delay! I wonder what kind of song you'll be singing for me, Shinada-san.
